subject: Urgent: AuroraSprint late-stage GPU supply sweep & contingency plan
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jun 2029 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: AuroraSprint late-stage GPU supply sweep & contingency plan

Team —

AuroraSprint is moving into final commercial review for the AS-Enterprise engagement (deal AS-2029-071). Legal wants procurement signals before the end of next week; the customer expects us to hold capacity so they can commit to a Q3 training ramp. High-level ask below:

- Baseline steady-state: 60 A100-equivalent GPUs for inference and fine-tune testing.
- Ramp window: up to ~150 equivalent GPUs within 8-12 weeks for iterative training bursts.
- First training burst target: week of 2029-07-15 (two-week window).

I need an internal availability snapshot and a recommended hold strategy by EOD Friday (2029-06-28):
1) Exact count of free GPUs (A100/H100) we can provision in us-west/us-east for July start.
2) Any conflicts with existing reserved pools or close-stage deals (calls out deal IDs if applicable).
3) Suggested hold: soft provisional hold (30/45 days) vs firm allocation and earliest start date we can honor.
4) Risk notes: fallback model variants, cross-region migration times, estimated cost uplift for on-call ramping.

Please attach the sizing sheet and indicate who on infra needs to be looped to enact a provisional hold. This is time-sensitive — Aurora expects a simple written commitment they can include in their procurement docs.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: request_context_brief.txt (txt)]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: AuroraSprint late-stage GPU supply sweep & contingency plan

Hannah —

Quick inventory snapshot across our US clusters as of 2029-06-27 09:00 PT:
- us-west-2 (primary, NV fleet): 42 free H100-equivalent slots (can be provisioned w/in 48–72 hrs)
- us-east-1 (secondary, GA fleet): 36 free A100-equivalent slots (provisioning ~72–96 hrs)
- us-central (overflow): 24 mixed-type slots (lower-cost preemptible/spot pool, eviction risk during peak)

Notes/recommendation:
- To meet the immediate July burst, we can offer a provisional soft-hold of 50 GPUs (mixture: 30 H100, 20 A100) for a 45-day window starting 2029-07-10. This balances current free capacity and leaves headroom for other committed deals.
- For the longer-term ramp to 150 GPUs within 8–12 weeks, we should plan a staged allocation: 50 (soft-hold) -> +50 (20–30 days later as we clear scheduled maintenance) -> +50 (as reserved pools free up or we provision extra racks).
- Potential conflict: Deal TR-2029-034 (reserved pool in us-west-2) has a tentative ramp queued for mid-July. If TR-2029-034 converts we may need to shift AuroraSprint partial capacity to us-east or on temporary H100 burst nodes (slightly higher price).

Attached is a sizing table with node counts and ETA for provisioning per region. For the provisional action we need:
- Approval from Sales leadership to place a 45-day soft hold (no billing change until contract signature, but removes capacity from public allocation).
- Ticket to Infra (Ops) to flag the node group for hold and to mark preferred node types.
- Legal note: we can provide a non-binding capacity reservation statement for their procurement package. If they want a committed reserved pool, we'd need a signed reserved capacity contract and a 3–6 week lead time for confirmed provisioning.

Attachment: aurorasprint_v1_sizing_table.xlsx (xlsx)

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Capacity Planning Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Park <jordan.park@aurorasprint.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AuroraSprint CTO <cto@aurorasprint.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jun 2029 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Urgent: AuroraSprint late-stage GPU supply sweep & contingency plan

Hannah / Marcus —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear options. We are under procurement pressure and need capacity assurances to finalize the purchase order. Our ask: can Redwood provision a provisional hold for 50 GPUs starting 2029-07-10 for 30 days? We prefer H100 for the first burst but can accept mixed types if needed.

We are ready to sign a provisional acceptance form and provide a PO to cover an initial deposit (payment terms to follow). If you can share a DocuSign link or provisional hold form, we will route it through procurement today.

Appreciate the staging plan — we expect to scale quickly if early tests hit targets. Please CC whoever will enact the hold so we have a single point of contact.

Regards,
Jordan Park
Head of Infrastructure | AuroraSprint
[jordan.park@aurorasprint.ai]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@aurorasprint.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Jun 2029 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: AuroraSprint late-stage GPU supply sweep & contingency plan

Jordan —

Understood and thanks for the clear ask. Summary and next steps from Redwood:

1) Provisional hold: Approve a 50-GPU provisional soft-hold (start 2029-07-10 for 30 days) — mixture we will provision: 30 H100 (us-west-2) + 20 A100 (us-east-1). This removes those slots from general allocation but is non-billable until contract signature.

2) Action owners: Marcus — open an Infra ticket and flag the node groups for soft-hold; Soojin — coordinate pricing/term note for procurement and prepare the provisional_hold_form.pdf; Aditya — prepare a short non-binding capacity note for your procurement package (one-pager).

3) Risks / fallbacks: If TR-2029-034 converts or infra pressure increases, we will notify you 72 hrs in advance and propose a cross-region shift; alternatives include short-lived H100 burst nodes (higher cost) or a split-burst plan.

4) Timeline: Marcus to confirm ticket & ETA by EOD Monday (2029-07-01). Soojin to push provisional form + DocuSign link by EOD Monday. Hannah will align with Sales leadership to approve the soft-hold; I will reply to your PO thread once hold is enacted.

Attachments: provisional_hold_form.pdf (pdf), aurorasprint_v1_sizing_table.xlsx (xlsx)

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
